title: Wisp SMP Texture Pack
description: Wisp SMP Texture Pack for your Minecraft Server
body: The Wisp SMP Texture Pack is the official resource pack designed for the Wisp SMP plugin. It adds custom textures, unique items, enhanced visuals, and special models required for the full gameplay experience. This pack is essential for correctly displaying all custom content and features available on Wisp SMP. Make sure to enable this resource pack before joining the server to enjoy the complete experience as intended.
